title: files.download request
description: plugin → companion, the payload of a `call` with op `files.download`. Download one file of the organization into the workspace, for the request the plugin is answering: an entry's attachment by its `id`, or a Files path. Exactly one of the two. The companion refuses a request it did not ring (`not_permitted`) and writes only inside its workspace.

attachmentId.description: An entry attachment's `id`, as a brief or an opener carried it.

path.description: A path in the organization's Files, as the platform's file tools name it.
